title: Römisches Österreich 47
summary: Since 1973, "Römisches Österreich" has regularly published scholarly articles on all aspects of ancient studies in Austria — covering archaeology, epigraphy, a…Since 1973, "Römisches Österreich" has regularly published scholarly articles on all aspects of ancient studies in Austria — covering archaeology, epigraphy, and numismatics — as well as contributions on neighbouring regions and adjacent periods (prehistory, the Middle Ages). The journal also features literature reports (research histories, reviews, responses), personal notices (obituaries, tributes), and in particular the "Annona Epigraphica Austriaca", dedicated to newly discovered inscriptions.
